messages:
sara: Quick sync — need to finalize intake + commitment expectations for the private preview cohort launching next month. Thoughts? :rocket:

matt: +1. What's target size? 10? 20?

sara: aiming 12-15 active partners. not too big for ops. each partner should commit 4 weeks of active feedback + 2 async weeks. time commitment ~3-6 hrs/week.

jen: we should lock success criteria early. ideas: 1) integration completed with sample app, 2) 2 or fewer critical regressions by EoP, 3) 10 reproducible issues filed. also qualitative: at least 2 partners willing to be references.

luke: from infra side — need clarity if partners will run on Dedicated or Private. also publish a minimal network/KMS checklist before onboarding.

amir: recruitment incentives? credits, advisory access, or swag?

sara: proposed incentives = $3k credit for Dedicated or $1500 cloud credit + 1 technical office-hour + invitation to advisory sync. NDA + active feedback commitment required.

ciara: I sketched a screening form in Figma. short and scoreable. snippet:

ciara: ```
1) Org size
2) Primary use case (chat / embeddings / batch)
3) Data sensitivity (PHI / PII / none)
4) Expected TPS and peak tokens/hr
5) Can you sign NDA? (yes/no)
6) Willing to join weekly 30m review? (yes/no)
```

matt: add two fields: "willingness to run our eval harness" and "primary contact (github handle)" so we're not stuck chasing people.

sara: yes — scoring: green/yellow/red. green -> auto-invite, yellow -> follow-up call, red -> decline. scoring rubric should be explicit.

recruiting-bot: New Typeform created: https://forms.typeform.com/to/abc123 (created by @ciara)

jen: feedback loop cadence proposal: weekly 30m engineering demo + async triage board (Linear) + a short weekly survey (3 Qs) to capture sentiment. eval rubric: functional correctness, latency delta, cost delta, integration friction.

luke: onboarding escape hatch: if partner integration results in >2 production incidents in first 30 days, we pause and move them to canary routing until fixed. document rollback steps in runbook.

amir: timeline? when will invites go out and cutoff for applicants?

sara: invites planned for next Tue. cutoff for intake = Fri EOD prior. onboarding kickoff start of the following week.

ciara: I'll own the screening form + scoring. matt -> eval harness. jen -> success metrics doc & rubric. luke -> infra & onboarding checklist. amir -> incentive comms + legal loop.

matt: I'll ship a lightweight eval script by Friday: `./eval/run_smoke.sh --sample 1000`

sara: action items repeated: ciara (form + scoring), matt (harness + script), jen (rubric + metrics), luke (infra checklist + rollback playbook), amir (incentives + NDA coordination). please confirm here.

ciara: confirmed :thumbsup:

matt: confirmed

jen: confirmed. I'll also draft the 3-question weekly survey (NPS-lite + 2 quick open fields).

luke: confirmed. will add network/KMS matrix and minimal VM sizing.

amir: I'll prep comms + loop legal for the NDA template.

sara: Thanks — I'll post the invite template + onboarding runbook later today and spin up the Linear board. :calendar: :eyes:
